# Government Funding Pathways

> A free, independent educational planner by Corey McDaniel (Tempe, Arizona) for two paths: forming a nonprofit and seeking grants, or financing a for-profit small business. It covers 9 U.S. states: Arizona, California, Texas, Florida, Wisconsin, Kentucky, Nevada, New Mexico, Iowa. It is not affiliated with any government agency and is not legal, financial or tax advice.

The planner has a nonprofit pathway (11 steps: mission, board, registered agent, state filing, EIN, bylaws, 501(c)(3), SAM.gov and Grants.gov, grant search, state compliance, other funding) and a business pathway (10 steps: entity, EIN and banking, documents, eligibility, SBDC counseling, lenders, application, underwriting, closing, repayment). Each state adds its filing office, fees and official links. Checklist progress is saved only in the browser; nothing is uploaded. Information as of October 2026.

## Planner

- [Government Funding Pathways](https://funding.coreymcdaniel.com/): choose a state and a pathway; add ?state=xx (for example ?state=ky) to open a state
